candidates.old:
BEQ by_cell
    STA fast_dst + 2
    LDA screen_start_address_low
    STA fast_dst + 1
    LDA lives                       \ lives_digits + 32 * (lives AND 15)
    ASL A
    ASL A
    ASL A
    ASL A
    ASL A                           \ A = 32 * (lives AND 7), C = lives bit 3
    TAX
    LDA #HI(lives_digits)
    ADC #0                          \ + bit 3 (C = 0 after: HI(lives_digits) < &FF)
    STA fast_src + 2
    TXA
    ADC #LO(lives_digits)
    STA fast_src + 1
    BCC fast_src_same_page
    INC fast_src + 2
.fast_src_same_page
    LDY #31
.fast_row
.fast_src
    LDA lives_digits,Y              \ self-modified: the digit's 32 bytes
.fast_dst
    STA &4000,Y                     \ self-modified: the screen start
    DEY
    BPL fast_row
    RTS
candidates.new:
BEQ by_cell
    STA fast_dst + 2
    STA lv_u2_dst + 2               \ the second half's page, unless the low byte carries (below)
    LDA screen_start_address_low
    STA fast_dst + 1
    CLC
    ADC #16                         \ the digit's second half: 16 bytes on
    STA lv_u2_dst + 1
    BCC lv_u2_dst_ok
    INC lv_u2_dst + 2
.lv_u2_dst_ok
    LDA lives                       \ lives_digits + 32 * (lives AND 15)
    ASL A
    ASL A
    ASL A
    ASL A
    ASL A                           \ A = 32 * (lives AND 7), C = lives bit 3
    TAX
    LDA #HI(lives_digits)
    ADC #0                          \ + bit 3 (C = 0 after: HI(lives_digits) < &FF)
    TAY
    TXA
    ADC #LO(lives_digits)
    STA fast_src + 1
    TYA
    ADC #0                          \ + the carry
    STA fast_src + 2
    TXA
    ADC #LO(lives_digits + 16)      \ (C = 0: the sum above is below &100)
    STA lv_u2_src + 1
    TYA
    ADC #HI(lives_digits + 16) - HI(lives_digits)
    STA lv_u2_src + 2
    LDY #15                         \ two bytes a turn: the digit's halves, 16 apart
.fast_row
.lv_u2_src
    LDA lives_digits + 16,Y         \ self-modified: the digit's second 16 bytes
.lv_u2_dst
    STA &4010,Y                     \ self-modified: the screen start + 16
.fast_src
    LDA lives_digits,Y              \ self-modified: the digit's first 16 bytes
.fast_dst
    STA &4000,Y                     \ self-modified: the screen start
    DEY
    BPL fast_row
    RTS
candidates.summary: Copy the lives digit two bytes a turn (the digit's halves 16 apart, 16 turns not 32): the loop drops from 447 to 367 cycles for 34 more in the set-up.
candidates.equivalence: Same 32 bytes copied, from lives_digits + 32*(lives AND 15) to screen_start_address (hi:lo), now as two 16-byte halves per turn: the second half's operands are the first half's + 16 (dst: ADC #16 on the low byte with BCC/INC for the page carry; src: branchless, hi = HI(lives_digits)+bit3 held in Y, each pair's low byte X+LO(lives_digits+k) with ADC #0 / ADC #(HI(ld+16)-HI(ld)) taking the carry; C is 0 at both ADC #LO (the preceding ADC #0 on a value < &FF cannot carry)). Y 15..0 reaches byte j and j+16 once each; the loop exits at Y=&FF as before; the second half is stored first so the last load is byte 0 as in the original (A on exit identical); X = 32*(lives AND 7) as before. No other RAM touched; the self-modified operands are all in this routine's own instructions (no interrupt runs it). The by_cell path is untouched; BEQ target unchanged by name.
candidates.relies_on: Page crossings: no hot branch or indexed read in this window changes its crossing behaviour by construction; measured on a scratch build (unshifted DEBUG_LIVES): the code after the routine slides up 31 bytes (30 for the second) (bank 4 SKIP PAD_END &B37D -> &B39C, 131 bytes free before: 100 left), lives_digits &9444 -> &9463, and pcprof's render cycles a pass fell 23430 -> 23394 (seed 1, 1500 passes) and 28406 -> 28351 (RIGHT held, 600 passes from 50), logic unchanged within 2, so the slide costs nothing measurable there. The indexed reads cross a page for the same bytes of the digit as before (each half's base + Y, Y <= 15, spans the same addresses). passlock 1500 passes seed 1 --screen: state and screen identical. Relies on: the only users of fast_src/fast_dst are in this routine (grep); BEQ by_cell still in range (by_cell now 0x4F bytes on); new labels lv_u2_src, lv_u2_dst, lv_u2_dst_ok are unique to this candidate and its alternative (shared by the two alternatives, which overlap). Callers (render.6502 JSR ren_plot_lives x2) reload A, X, Y and use no flags after it; Y still exits at &FF and A = digit byte 0 as before. The low-byte carry of screen_start_address_low + 16 (L >= 240) and of lives_digits + 32*d + 16 are both handled.
